scenarios.name: carrier API returns 503 three times
scenarios.invariant: retries must not produce a second submission
scenarios.notes: the carrier endpoint was called 4 times: three answered 503 and one succeeded. Restate retried the durable step and 1 submission landed.

scenarios.name: worker killed while awaiting human approval
scenarios.invariant: a restart must not lose case state
scenarios.notes: the workflow was suspended on a durable promise, so the kill cost nothing and the approval given after the restart still resolved it.

scenarios.name: the same carrier rejection delivered twice
scenarios.invariant: a duplicate external event must not duplicate side effects
scenarios.notes: the second delivery was rejected by the durable promise, which had already been resolved, so exactly one challenge reached the carrier.

scenarios.name: human approves the same action twice
scenarios.invariant: a consequential action executes at most once per intent
scenarios.notes: the second approval was absorbed; one submission reached the carrier.

scenarios.name: human rejects the pending submission
scenarios.invariant: a rejected action must never execute
scenarios.notes: the carrier was never called at all; the rejection branch returns before any side effect is reachable.

scenarios.name: worker killed in the window around the submission
scenarios.invariant: a crash around a side effect must not double it
scenarios.notes: the carrier saw 2 attempt(s) and 1 landed. Where the retry did reach the carrier twice, the replay-stable idempotency key made the second one a no-op.
